  * Executes `INSERT INTO facts` / `INSERT INTO ticks`:
    * [`libs/engine/src/engine/arrival_store.py:296-298`](file:///private/tmp/claude-501/wt-sliceB-explore/libs/engine/src/engine/arrival_store.py#L296-L298):
      ```python
      self._db.execute(
          FACT_INSERT_SQL if t == "fact" else TICK_INSERT_SQL, row

      ```
  * SQL statements defined at:
    * [`libs/engine/src/engine/sqlite_store.py:131`](file:///private/tmp/claude-501/wt-sliceB-explore/libs/engine/src/engine/sqlite_store.py#L131): `FACT_INSERT_SQL = _insert_sql("facts", FACT_COLUMNS)`

* **In `JsonlStore` during `catch_up` and `_rebuild`**:
  * Called from `catch_up` via `_tail_forward` -> `_index_lines` ([`libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py:725`](file:///private/tmp/claude-501/wt-sliceB-explore/libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py#L725), [`libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py:919`](file:///private/tmp/claude-501/wt-sliceB-explore/libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py#L919)).
  * Called from `_rebuild` via `_index_lines(0, 0, 0, rebuilding=True)` ([`libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py:963`](file:///private/tmp/claude-501/wt-sliceB-explore/libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py#L963)).
  * Executes `INSERT INTO facts` / `INSERT INTO ticks` inside `_index_lines`:
    * [`libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py:889-891`](file:///private/tmp/claude-501/wt-sliceB-explore/libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py#L889-L891):

    * [`libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py:911`](file:///private/tmp/claude-501/wt-sliceB-explore/libs/engine/src/engine/jsonl_store.py#L911): `self._stamp(end, base_facts + facts, base_ticks + ticks)`

      ```python
          (key, str(value)),

      ```
